text:
Grab's full-time headcount grew from 11,267 at the end of 2024 to 12,012 at the end of 2025, an increase of 745 employees (about 6.6%) [Grab, FY2024, p.161; Grab, FY2025, p.117].

By function, the growth was concentrated in Operations, support and supermarket retail (6,055 → 6,888) and Research and development (2,934 → 2,964), while General and administrative (1,425 → 1,375) and Sales and marketing (853 → 785) headcount declined [Grab, FY2024, p.161; Grab, FY2025, p.117]. Part of the 2025 total reflects acquisitions — 865 employees from Everrise (a Malaysian supermarket chain acquired in March 2025) and 22 from Infermove (an AI robotics startup acquired in December 2025) — compared with 321 Nham24 employees included in the 2024 total [Grab, FY2025, p.117; Grab, FY2024, p.161].

In addition to full-time staff, Grab also had 1,242 fixed-term contract employees and 3,956 temporary agency workers at end-2025, versus 1,299 fixed-term and 3,795 temporary agency workers at end-2024 [Grab, FY2025, p.117; Grab, FY2024, p.161].
